Bug_Title: ASE: Method invoked in assertion may produce a side effect (ASE_ASSERTION_WITH_SIDE_EFFECT_METHOD)
Bug_Details:
Expressions used in assertions must not produce side effects. See SEI CERT Rule EXP06
for more information.
 SEI CERT Rule EXP06
Bug_Explanation: The method incrementCounter() is invoked within an assertion, which causes a side effect by incrementing the counter. Assertions should not include expressions that change the state of the program.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method, which contains an assertion that calls incrementCounter(). This causes a side effect (incrementing the counter) and results in an AssertionError when assertions are enabled, causing the test to fail.
